name: claude-proxy
description: Universal Claude-compatible proxy: route Claude Code CLI / Claude Desktop through any OpenAI-compatible API. Discovers models, aliases arbitrary names, and bypasses the 'claude|anthropic' model-name guard.

scripts.build: bun build src/cli.ts --target=bun --outdir=dist && bun build src/web/index.html --target=browser --outdir=dist/web && cp -r src/web dist/web
